topic: reject a review finding that contradicts the contract
lesson: The performance lens asked windowMatchesPeriod to 'include the requested grain'. REJECTED: AppliedTimeWindow (selectionExecutor.ts:17) is {from,to,column} and carries no grain, and reaching back for selection.timeWindow.grain would break the case the matcher exists for - a clicked single-day period and a natural-language whole month are the SAME period and must match the same entry. Verify a finding against the type before acting on it; two of this task's findings were wrong (the other claimed chat.service.ts is prettier-ignored, which it is not). The neighbouring real gap - the matcher ignored the time column - was tightened instead.
